introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: At AthletiX, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, use our services, or communicate with us.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content: We use your information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you, and ensure the security of our platform.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to remember your language preferences and improve your experience on our platform.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. Contact us to exercise these rights.
